title: Bobo's Rainbow

coreLoop: tap anywhere to move Bobo horizontally toward the touch point
catch regular pink and blue hearts; each regular heart advances the 12-heart restoration objective
golden hearts grant optional bonus score but do not replace a restoration heart
every two regular catches restore one rainbow band
twelve regular catches restore all six bands and complete the game as a win
missed hearts drift away without lives, penalties, combo reset, or a failure state
difficulty rises gently within the single session and remains bounded
restart from the result card to begin a fresh run
fairness: the first regular collectible must be reachable early in the session
tap-to-move clamps Bobo inside the playfield and responds without lane lock
regular-heart spawn timing and fall speed remain bounded and catchable
golden hearts are optional rewards and are never required to complete the objective
misses never remove progress or end the run; only twelve regular catches complete the win
the result card communicates the restored rainbow and provides a reliable replay action

reviewFocus: Check that the bear, kitten, hearts, and rainbow read clearly at portrait mobile size.
Check whether collecting hearts visibly repairs the rainbow and communicates progress toward helping the kitten.
Verify that missed hearts never create a loss state and that twelve regular catches complete the win.
Check touch targets, contrast, HUD overlap, and whether the restart affordance is actually usable.
Verify that pink and blue regular hearts each increment the 12-heart restoration objective by exactly one, while golden hearts add bonus score without advancing restoration progress.
Verify the six rainbow bands reveal only after 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, and 12 regular hearts; the game wins only at 12 regular hearts, regardless of golden-heart bonus score.
